0022600196.text: The Bulls (1-6, on a five-game losing streak and 13th in the East) host the 76ers (7-1, first in the East and the Atlantic, on a four-game winning streak), with Chicago 0-2 at home this season and Philadelphia 3-0 on the road. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring strain) and Jalen Smith (day-to-day, hand, a game-time decision), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture). The Bulls trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 126-107 loss in Philadelphia, though they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
